LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N001_Text:
My name is Suiyin. I get some of the news from your side. It arrives late, and it is not always right.

More ratkin are on the roads. Some want food, some want to trade, and some will take what they can. Do not open the door because I wrote this. I am not vouching for them.

I will write again when there is more to say.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N002_Text:
More news has reached me. {0} different kinds of visitors have passed through your colony lately.

Some wanted a meal; others needed a place to stay. Some were hardly polite when they arrived, but ended up staying too. Hearing that they have somewhere to live is always a relief.

You do not need to write back. I will keep asking around.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N003_Text:
I paid for the silver that arrived, all {0} of it.

I asked someone to take a detour. He complained that carrying so little was not worth the trip, then came back asking when the next run would be. I have not promised him another.

The money is there. Use it for what you need now. You do not have to take anyone in to repay the favor.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004ChildAlone_Text:
The child lingers where the basket used to be. It has been taken apart, and the boards used elsewhere.

"Where did mother go?"

That is what the child asks.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004FamilyHere_Text: The child finds the mother first. They do not say much.\n\n"You're still here. That's what matters..."
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Captive_Text: The child has learned to watch people's faces. At least the child is alive, and staying that way has become a daily task.\n\nSuiyin adds a short line beside the child's name.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Story_Text: The room has been cleared. In a while, the map will not show what happened here.\n\nSuiyin does not write any more.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Banished_Text: You sent them beyond the border. There are fewer people to care for, and empty beds.\n\nA caravan may meet the survivor again within {0} years.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Revisit_Text: The caravan sees them on the road. The survivor has learned to find food, and the old cloth still bears the colony's colors.\n\nYou can leave them by the road, or pay {0} silver and receive {2} silver after {1} years. You can also kill them and end the matter here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004RescuePaid_Text: The {0} silver has been paid. They have promised to send {2} silver after {1} years. Let's hope there is still news of them by then.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Killed_Text: Suiyin writes only one sentence: "It ends here."
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Regret_Text:
The mother still walks to the old spot. The child is no longer there.

"If only that day..."

She does not finish the sentence.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Accepted_Text: The food has been handed over, and the exchange checked again.\n\nThe young ratkin are still here. Someone still needs to arrange their next meal and a place to sleep tonight.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Cared_Text: Over the past few days, someone has always had to stop work to watch the child. At least the crying no longer begins with a question about what name to use.\n\nShould we use the old name again?
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Dead_Text: Not every child survived. May the glitterworld they have gone to be free of famine.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Left_Text: The child is no longer in your care. How will the next person look after the child? We have no way of knowing.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Missing_Text: The child never settled here. We have no way of knowing what happened, and can only hope there is a future ahead.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Rejected_Text: The exchange fell through. The young ratkin were taken away in a hurry.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005TimedOut_Text: The agreed time passed without an answer. The young ratkin were taken away.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Broken_Text: The planned handover never happened. It seems the agreed terms no longer stand.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Entry_Text: A few mouthfuls are missing from the food store. There is a narrow hole at the foot of the wall, with crumbs caught around its edge. It looks like ratkin have eaten here, perhaps after gnawing through the floor.\n\nYou can seal it with {0} wood, leave a portion of food as bait, or clear the area around it. Clearing destroys up to {1} nearby portions of food. Left alone, the hole will disappear after {2} days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Sealed_Text: The hole is filled. Today's count matches again.\n\nNobody goes to see who was on the other side.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006BaitSet_Text: Food is by the hole. Tonight there is one portion less. Check the trail after a day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006BaitGone_Text: The bait is gone. There is a fresh trail outside. One more rain and it will be hard to read.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Traced_Text: A place has been marked along the trail. Someone still has to walk there to see what is inside.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Stopped_Text: The trail ends here. The hole has been sealed.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Cleaned_Text: You turn over the places around the hole where food could hide. The scraps come out, and they cannot be eaten.\n\nAt least nobody has to watch the gap tonight.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Gone_Text: When you look again, the hole is gone. That path cannot be followed.
LanguageData.RHAH_Hole_NoWood: Not enough wood. Sealing the hole requires {0}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Hole_NoFood: No food by the hole to use as bait.
LanguageData.RHAH_Hole_Stale: This hole can no longer be handled.
LanguageData.RHAH_Quarantine_Stale: This group can no longer take that choice.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Choice_Text: Some of the visitors have ratkin plague. Some are still on their feet; others already need care.\n\nYou can keep them under observation, let them go, or postpone the decision. The plague needs treatment, and those you release still need the strength to leave. Restrictions on joining, hiring, and trading depend on your quarantine settings.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Quarantine_Text: The sick stay for now. They still need care. A sentence telling them not to leave is not care.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Release_Text: You let them continue their journey. Some move at once; others must wait until they can manage it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Defer_Text: The sick stay as they are. The disease is still there, and the choice is still open.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Broken_Text: Someone still infected left the map. The rest are no longer held.\n\nWhere the ones who left went is not visible from here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Recovered_Text: The recovered visitors have left. This time, they do not have to carry the plague with them.\n\nLet's hope they only want a meal next time we meet.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Stayed_Text: The recovered people stay in the colony. The sick beds are empty. They still need a place of their own.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Missing_Text: The visitors who had plague have gone missing. After a long wait, there is still no word of them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Return_Text: There is a familiar face outside. The plague was gone when this visitor last left.\n\nThis time, the request is only for a meal. You can welcome the visitor or send them on their way.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Arrive_Text:
"We... want to trade for food."

{0} tries to put the words in order.

"We need food, and we need to know which roads are still open. Give me {1} simple meals, and I will tell you where an old store is. You can check my story first, if you want."

The visitor will wait {2} days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Trade_Text: "Enough. Don't bring any more. I can't carry all that by myself."\n\n{0} gives you the promised location and checks the way home once more.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Proof_Text: "That part checks out. I can't promise the rest, and you don't have to believe me yet."\n\n{0} kinds of events have been corroborated. The exchange is still available.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008NoProof_Text: "I may have come to the wrong place."\n\nThe visitor leaves.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Refuse_Text: "Forget it, then. I still need to get out before dark."
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Drive_Text: The visitor was driven off by force.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Dead_Text: The visitor who asked the way has died, leaving no information behind.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Left_Text: The visitor who asked the way has left the area.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Missing_Text: The visitor who asked the way is missing.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Timeout_Text: The agreed time has passed without an exchange. The visitor leaves, dejected.
LanguageData.RHAH_Envoy_NoMeals: Not enough simple meals. The exchange requires {0}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Envoy_Stale: This matter can no longer be handled.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Arrive_Text:
The grain you expected is not here. The box holds hauling lists, ration counts, and a stack of damp paper.

A number on the top sheet was changed twice. The last correction is unsigned.

The site remains available for {0} days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Take_Text: Everything that can be carried has been packed. Some pages are stuck together; don't pull them apart yet.\n\nYou also brought back {0} silver.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Leave_Text: You do not take the box. The place is noted. Whether the next group takes it is not decided here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Hand_Text: The records go to them. The silver is {0}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Share_Text: You keep a copy. They keep the other. There is no silver now, and no promise that it comes back.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Destroy_Text: The paper and the box are no longer usable. There is no second copy here to check the list against.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Empty_Text: The place is still there. What could be taken is already gone. The walk brought nothing back.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Journal_Text: Another group has reached your colony. I will write down what I have heard so far, and keep asking about what happens next.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_1: The young ratkin are here, but whoever brought them has gone. Were they sent to the wrong place, or left here on purpose?
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_2: The visitor used the wrong name. The name can be corrected. Staying is separate.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_3: The mothers are in labor and still on the road. They need somewhere to rest, and food for the children about to be born.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_4: This group only intends to pass through. They will stop a while, then keep going.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_5: A grain sack is short. We do not know whether the people who took it will travel far or wait for another chance.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_6: There were many people at the gate. The fates that can be checked are written down.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_7: Someone is offering information for supplies. A place marked on the map still needs a visit before we can know whether the story is true.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_8: A caravan has arrived with goods. They want to make their sales, then continue on their own road.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_9: The besiegers came with hostile intent. We have to defend this place first.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_10: After this group passed, the food on the ground and the living both changed.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_11: The visitors arrived sick. Calling it revenge does not name who sent them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_12: The people on the road wanted the caravan's supplies. Paying or fighting is the caravan's own cost.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_13: They came alone. Nobody traveling with them can answer for them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Journal_14: They have come asking for aid. What you can give depends on your own stores. Let's hope it lasts until the next place with food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_1_Text: Someone is talking about a child's place again. The last time does not decide this one.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_2_Text: The grain trail has another place. Do not treat them as the same until someone walks there.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_3_Text: Someone can travel again, so news can arrive again. Whether this visitor heard about the quarantine still has to be asked.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_4_Text: The place he named is there. This time, the thing he promised is actually in it.
